---
name: Normative ambiguity or inconsistency
about: Report an unclear, conflicting or incomplete SDAF requirement
title: "[Normative] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## SDAF version

Identify the version concerned, for example `1.0`.

## Requirement location

Identify the applicable Part, annex, section and requirement number.

## Requirement text

Quote only the minimum wording necessary to identify the issue.

## Nature of the issue

Select all that apply:

- [ ] Ambiguous wording
- [ ] Conflict between requirements
- [ ] Missing applicability condition
- [ ] Undefined or inconsistent terminology
- [ ] Unclear conformance expectation
- [ ] Unclear evidence or assurance requirement
- [ ] Other

## Competing interpretations

Describe the reasonable interpretations or possible applications of the requirement.

## Practical consequence

Explain how the ambiguity affects implementation, evidence, decision-making, conformance or assurance.

## Supporting evidence

Provide relevant implementation experience, standards references, examples or other evidence.

## Proposed resolution

Suggest revised wording or another resolution, if available.

## Dependency and impact considerations

Identify any other requirements, annexes, templates, examples or decisions that could be affected.

## Submission checks

- [ ] I searched existing open and closed issues for the same matter.
- [ ] I separated observed facts from my interpretation and proposed solution.
- [ ] I have not included confidential, personal or proprietary information.
- [ ] I have identified any third-party material and relevant restrictions.
